vetSays.line: 🛡️ Skylar, the person in their 20s and the woman in her 30s met them at the door — 3 put down. Skylar, the person in their 20s, the woman in her 30s are hurt.
🛡️ Skylar, Salvatore, Antonio and Lucia met them at the door — 4 put down. Skylar, Salvatore, Antonio, Lucia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Salvatore, Antonio, Adil and Lucia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Salvatore, Antonio, Adil, Lucia are hurt.
🛡️ Skylar, Salvatore, Antonio and Adil met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Skylar, Salvatore, Antonio, Adil are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Salvatore just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Salvatore just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Salvatore, Antonio, Olivia and Dale met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Antonio, Olivia, Dale are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Kelly showed Dale the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Kelly showed Antonio the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Adil showed Lucia the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Raeesa just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl met them at the door — 1 put down. Vasyl is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Scarred Big Loud and an eye-head (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

regDeaths.name: the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a soft green glow under the water
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
